APPROVE

APPROVE

merge-lane-2's review of the nc-head-commit 4ccb39b68adcb582b1594fab01cd36158f654cc7, round 1.

Review tier: no-reviewer-tier, because the pull request changes only prose. No reviewer ran, and the tier called for none. merge-lane-2 checked that the pull request changes nothing but that prose.

Checked against the repository and the walk-minutes, not taken from the description:
- Every changed phrase matches the #new texts of item 74 of approval-walk ned-box-helper-push-program-design-points-2026-11-03, which the user approved with "A" on 2026-11-18 22:59Z (its minutes, line 552); checked phrase by phrase with a word diff against main.
- The head 4ccb39b68 merges origin/main in, with no other change.

Drift lint (scripts/md-drift-lint.py) on the changed Markdown at the head: no findings (exit 0).

APPROVE

merge-lane-1 review, round 2 of head a7bbc10132d3914974aa191d2d33f125ae161cd7 (main merged into the approved head 4ccb39b68adc after the merge queue held it as DIRTY). Approved.

- **Tier:** no-reviewer-tier (`scripts/pull-request-review-plan.py`: both files change only prose outside fenced code blocks), so merge-lane-1 read the diff itself; no Codex review cell and no head tests ran.
- **Merge resolution:** against main 4bb7b19d0 the pull request still changes only `nn-systems/handoff/handoff.system.design.md` and `nn-systems/cold-read/cold-read-grid-cell-failure-handling.tool.design.md`, and the head merges cleanly. The "Dated decisions" bullet "A reincarnate-seat waits for the agent-session's running subagents" keeps main's text and gains only this pull request's two approved changes.
- **Figures checked against the code:** `BACKGROUND_TASK_WAIT_LIMIT_MINUTES_BY_KIND` in `scripts/handoff-context-threshold-hook.py` on main gives nn-mutation-testing 105, test-suite 90 and waiting-task 0, and `BACKGROUND_TASK_WAIT_LIMIT_MINUTES_WHEN_NO_KIND_MATCHES` is 75, as the new text says.
- **User approval:** each of the eight changed passages is word for word a part of item 74 of 184 of approval-walk ned-box-helper-push-program-design-points-2026-11-03, which the user answered "A" at 2026-11-18 22:59Z (its walk-minutes, line 552). So no hold.
- **Description:** it still names the two files by their old paths, `nn-systems/handoff/handoff-design.md` and `nn-systems/cold-read/cold-read-grid-cell-failure-handling-design.md`; main has since renamed them as above. Not graded, since a description changes nothing on main.

**Nit, fix-in-maintenance** (inline): the approved reason sentence says "nc-mutation-testing", which main renamed to nn-mutation-testing.

For each finding you fix, say in the fix commit's message whether the finding is one case of a wider pattern; if it is, name the pattern. Fix the other cases in this pull request when they run the same test suites or a reviewer would check them the same way; list in the commit message any you leave for a follow-up pull request. After the merge, merge-lane-2 sends you that list, as it does non-blocking findings, and you open a follow-up pull request for them or tell merge-lane-2 why not.
